title: Apple's in the Penalty Box, but Should Still Be in Your Starting Lineup
text:
Apple's in the Penalty Box, but Should Still Be in Your Starting Lineup By 0 
Recently, I visited an Apple (AAPL) store to get a new battery for my iPhone 7. The phone doesn't hold a charge as well as it once did. 
I waited in a long, fast-moving line. It seems that many people had the same idea.
